children: MEXICO CITY, Sept 4 (Reuters) - Mexican gross fixed investment rose 1.3 percent in June from the previous month, the national statistics agency said on Friday.
The measure of spending on machinery, equipment and new construction was up 7.7 percent from the same month a year earlier.
